description: This file contains the implementation of the HTTP_Session class, which manages HTTP sessions including starting, stopping, setting variables, handling expiration and idle timeouts, and configuration related to session storage. It also defines related constants for session states.

classes.name: HTTP_Session
classes.description: A class for managing HTTP sessions, providing methods for starting, stopping, configuring, and managing session state, expiration, and other session-related features.

methods.name: setContainer
methods.description: Sets user-defined session storage functions, allowing storage in custom backends like a database.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes session data, creates or resumes a session with optional custom session ID.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Writes session data and ends session, releasing lock to allow concurrent requests.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Unsets all session variables and destroys session data in storage.

methods.name: regenerateId
methods.description: Generates a new session ID, optionally deleting old session data.

methods.name: replicate
methods.description: Copies session data of the specified session ID to another table; requires a container.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Frees all session variables, resetting session state.

methods.name: detectID
methods.description: Attempts to find a session ID in GET, POST, or COOKIE variables.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Gets or sets the name of the session cookie.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Gets or sets the session ID.

methods.name: setExpire
methods.description: Sets the maximum expiration time for the session.

methods.name: setIdle
methods.description: Sets the maximum idle timeout for the session.

methods.name: sessionValidThru
methods.description: Returns the time until the session is considered idle or expired.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the session has expired based on the set timeout.

methods.name: isIdle
methods.description: Checks whether the session has been idle longer than the maximum idle time.

methods.name: updateIdle
methods.description: Updates the timestamp indicating last activity for idle timeout calculations.

methods.name: useCookies
methods.description: Enables or disables cookie-based session IDs and returns previous setting.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Determines if the current session was created in the current request.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Deprecated method to register variables; recommends using set()/setRef().

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Deprecated method to unregister variables; use get()/getRef().

methods.name: registered
methods.description: Deprecated method to check registration status; use is_set().

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a session variable's value.

methods.name: getRef
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to a session variable.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a session variable's value.

methods.name: setRef
methods.description: Sets a session variable by reference.

methods.name: is_set
methods.description: Checks if a session variable is set.

methods.name: getLocal
methods.description: Gets a local (script-specific) variable stored in session.

methods.name: setLocal
methods.description: Sets a local (script-specific) variable in session.

methods.name: localName
methods.description: Gets or sets the local storage name for script variables.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes session configuration upon class load.

methods.name: useTransSID
methods.description: Enables or disables URL-transmitted session IDs.

methods.name: setGcMaxLifetime
methods.description: Sets or retrieves the session garbage collection maximum lifetime.

methods.name: setGcProbability
methods.description: Sets or retrieves the probability for garbage collection runs.
